status: new independently documented coefficient convention; numerical and source gates required before separate holdout assessment

source.authors: C. G. Speziale, R. Raj, T. B. Gatski
source.title: Modeling the Dissipation Rate in Rotating Turbulent Flows
source.definition: Equation (11) and the following paragraph explicitly identify the Pope correction with C1=1.44, C2=1.92, C3=0.79. This differs from the 1.45/1.90 pair printed in Pope 1978. Both conventions are retained; no assertion is made about the undocumented details of the 1978 calculation.

transport_constants_source: Official OpenFOAM v2212 standard k-epsilon documentation: Cmu=0.09, sigma_k=1, sigma_e=1.3; same transport constants as printed in Pope 1978
selection: Assess both previously frozen production approximations, not whichever looks better against the holdout. No new coefficients are searched, optimized or interpolated. The original 1978-printed candidates remain failed source reproductions.
numerical_gates: All basic and refinement gates in solve_kepsilon_profile.py, with limits unchanged from kepsilon_profile_protocol.json. Include edge-tail, solver-tolerance and initial-mesh comparisons; positive finite states and inactive numerical safeguards are mandatory.

source_gate.source: Pope 1978 independently measured round-jet slope and corrected-model calibration. Passing is agreement with this source rate, not proof of a faithful reproduction of the undocumented 1978 implementation.

holdout: Unchanged Hussein 1994 reference.json, all profile and integral criteria, 20% relative threshold, 201 radial points over eta in [0,0.2]; no width/coordinate rescaling or coefficient fit
momentum_convention: Existing top-hat nozzle mean momentum: B=1/sqrt(8 I2), alpha=2 B I1. RANS normal-stress/pressure flux effects are omitted, reported as a limitation, and not fitted.
scope_limits: The 1990 report finds that Pope's correction gives the same deficient predictions as the standard model for rotating isotropic turbulence and rotating homogeneous shear. It does not establish a general rotation/swirl closure.

This self-similar boundary-layer reduction omits axial diffusion, streamwise radial-velocity gradients in shear/rotation, and axial normal-stress transport. The normal-production diagnostic is not full RANS.
RANS k is not automatically unresolved LES energy. No production waterjet enablement or measured droplet-transport validation follows from a gas profile check.
